name: @cinatra-ai/blog-image-generator-agent
description: Stateless leaf agent that settles the featured image of a blog post. It reads the draft post and returns exactly ONE image record - the placement (always featured), the post the picture belongs to, the prompt the picture is made from, and alternative text - never a list. No body pictures and no picture count: one post, one picture. It writes its own prompt and is handed none: it replaces the retired prompt-list agent, so no second agent feeds this one. The picture BYTES are not filed with the record, and not for want of a declaration here: every write road an agent can take - a declarative EndNode artifact binding, the artifact_materialize passthrough, an artifact_authoring_emit claim - is scoped in v1 to the text-authorable types (text/markdown, text/plain, text/html, application/json, application/xml), while the picture's own type @cinatra-ai/blog-image-artifact:blog-image accepts only image/png, image/jpeg and image/webp. The two sets do not meet, so no road reaches a picture and the record travels alone until one opens - carrying, unchanged, the two fields that type requires: the post and the placement. Single bridge invocation; the bridge node declares an empty toolbox list (data.toolbox_ids: []), so the host attaches no toolbox to the turn and the answer follows the node own JSON contract. Returns strict JSON {image:{placement,post,prompt,altText}, notes}.
